title: Coupon
description: A Stigg coupon providing a percentage or fixed discount on a subscription or customer account.

discountValue.description: The discount amount or percentage value.

discountType.description: Whether the discount is a percentage or fixed monetary amount.

currency.description: Currency code for fixed-amount coupons (e.g., usd).

maxRedemptions.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed. Null means unlimited.

redemptionsCount.description: Number of times this coupon has been redeemed.

isArchived.description: Whether this coupon is archived and no longer usable.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the coupon was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the coupon was last updated.
